review_output: {"summary":"I found no blocking regression in the reset change or the locator and wait repair. `onReset={e => e.preventDefault()}` is the right narrow fix. It keeps the controlled select, datetime and title DOM values aligned with React state after React's post-action `form.reset()`. It also leaves the hidden `requestId` and CSRF inputs untouched. The unit test models the browser order (cancelable event first, then conditional default reset), so it fails if the handler is removed. The e2e assertions still check the completion lock, the exact 3 controls and fresh intent via full navigation. Two low-severity verification gaps remain.
